slices.focus: House renovation reaches practical completion, freeing Saira to plan for a cat and Lisbon holiday
slices.summary: Saira and Tom paint the last upstairs wall and clear landing boxes, marking the house as 'finished enough'. Saira allows herself to plan a Lisbon holiday and consider adopting a calm adult rescue cat. She sets three steps: book Lisbon dates, hang wall art, then low-pressure cat research.

Wall art not yet hung (landing priority)
Cat non-negotiables list not yet finalized
Need to avoid slipping back into 'one more month' postponement mentality
